patterns: APPSC asks AP sites by phase: Billasurgam (Palaeolithic), Giddaluru (microlithic), Patapadu/Keesarapalli (Chalcolithic), plus megalith types by AP district.
Megalith definition items (graves with goods ringed by big stones = megaliths) and statement-incorrect items on AP megalith distribution recur.
Technique/site one-liners: Levallois at Sembur; Bhimbetka discovered by Wakankar (1957), famous for rock paintings; Burzahom pit dwellings and dog burials.
Other PSCs ask first-evidence items: domestication at Bagor/Adamgarh (Mesolithic), earliest man in Narmada valley, ash mounds at Sanganakallu.
App leans on match/statement sets covering Chalcolithic pottery and dates and recent finds (Mayiladumparai, Karivalamvanthanallur) beyond PYQ depth.
